exposure: endoscopic laser coagulation of placental vessels (ELCPV)
cohort: The study included 373 monochorionic twin pregnancies complicated with twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS) treated with ELCPV, compared with 243 normal monochorionic pregnancies.
finding: Monochorionic twin pregnancies treated with laser coagulation of placental vascular anastomoses, particularly using the Solomon technique, showed an increased risk of placental abruption.
